subject.title: feat(plugins): add Control UI entry points

question: Should the first Plugin UI Entry Point API expose `same-window` and `new-window`, or should v1 be limited to sandboxed in-app entries until isolated-origin top-level plugin pages are designed?
rationale: This choice defines a new public plugin browser trust boundary; automation can remove modes mechanically, but it cannot decide whether OpenClaw wants to support top-level same-origin plugin pages as product/API policy.

options.title: Limit v1 to sandboxed in-app entries
options.body: Remove or disable `same-window` and `new-window` so plugin UI launches only through the iframe bridge covered by the current token and route-containment model.

options.title: Design isolated top-level plugin pages
options.body: Keep top-level modes only after defining origin/storage isolation and adding focused proof that plugin JavaScript cannot read Control UI auth/settings state.

options.title: Pause under the broader RFC
options.body: Hold this PR until the broader Control UI contribution-slot RFC settles the plugin UI API vocabulary and browser security model.

recommendation.title: Limit v1 to sandboxed in-app entries
recommendation.body: Remove or disable `same-window` and `new-window` so plugin UI launches only through the iframe bridge covered by the current token and route-containment model.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the related Control UI contribution-slot RFC and authored the host-hook foundation this public SDK/API surface extends.
